verdict.line: You lose if Garen lands Q (Decisive Strike) first and silences you into his damage window; you win if you land E (Apprehend) first and finish the stick before his passive ticks.

brief.thesis: Garen's Perseverance passive heals back any damage he hasn't taken recently, so single pokes do nothing — you have to hook him with E (Apprehend) and burn through the full Q-W-auto combo in one uninterrupted trade. Apprehend's passive armor shred on top of stacking Hemorrhage is what lets your damage outrun his regen, which is exactly why the 51.8% win rate over 5,236 games skews toward you rather than being even.

theirWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is up before you engage
theirWindow.what: He can use the Move Speed burst to close or disengage and the empowered next attack silences you, cutting off your E (Apprehend) pull or R (Noxian Guillotine) for its 8s cooldown window. Don't throw E into a fight where he can press Q first — bait it out with a minion-crossing auto instead.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Decisive Strike) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: He has no slow-break and no silence threat, so land E (Apprehend) to pull him in, then Q (Decimate) for the blade-edge heal, W (Crippling Strike) to lock him in range, and stack Hemorrhage to 5 before his Perseverance starts mattering.

powerCurve.note: Neither combo is online, passive regen nullifies poke
E (Apprehend) online, forces full trades before he heals
R (Guillotine) true damage outpaces his R execute threat
W (Courage) damage reduction closes the gap
Duel relevance fades, teamfight positioning decides it

start.why: Measured as the stronger start here (51.4% over 5,768 games, 85.8% pick) — the AD and sustain let you win the extended trades E (Apprehend) forces without needing the shield variant's passive mitigation.

boots.why: 50.7% over 4,859 games and 74.6% pick — Garen's auto-reliant W (Courage) and E (Judgment) spin are both physical, so the flat reduction directly undercuts his trade damage.

core.why: Highest-winning path first item (56.4% over 691 games) — the active haste lets you stick through his Q (Decisive Strike) speed burst instead of losing the follow-up.
Builds the move speed you need to re-engage after he Q's away, and the health keeps you alive through his W (Courage) damage reduction phase.
The highest win-rate finisher on this path (56.4% combined) — bleeds through his Perseverance heal rather than trading burst-for-burst against a champion whose passive punishes single hits.

situational.when: he's building toward a late Demacian Justice execute and you need the shield to survive the R threshold
the game goes long and the enemy team adds magic damage alongside Garen's physical pressure

runes.keystoneWhy: Garen's Perseverance means short trades heal off — Conqueror's stacking adaptive force rewards the exact prolonged, E-initiated brawl this matchup requires, and the healing on fully stacked gives you the edge in the extended duel his passive is built to survive.

summoners.why: Flash+Ghost is both the most-picked (67.7%) and highest-winning (51.6%) combo here — Ghost closes the gap to force the E (Apprehend) engage before Garen's Q (Decisive Strike) lets him kite away. Flash+Ignite (49.7%, 27.3% pick) is the alternative if you want to force kills through his Perseverance regen instead.

playing.title: Bait Q before you engage
playing.detail: Walk up for a single auto near minions to make him want to use Q (Decisive Strike) for the trade. Once it's down, there's no silence or slow-break left to stop your E (Apprehend).

playing.title: Pull, don't poke
playing.detail: Single autos heal off via Perseverance within seconds. Only commit damage when you can follow E (Apprehend) immediately into Q (Decimate) and W (Crippling Strike) in one unbroken sequence.

playing.title: Hit the blade edge, not the handle
playing.detail: Decimate deals more damage and heals you only when the champion is struck by the blade — stand so Garen is at the far edge of your swing, as OP.GG's own read confirms, not tucked against you.

playing.title: Track stacks to 5 for the enrage
playing.detail: At max Hemorrhage stacks you gain massively increased Attack Damage — this is the point to commit Noxian Guillotine (120/100/80/6/6s cooldown) rather than before stacks are full.

playing.title: Respect his R past 50% missing health
playing.detail: Demacian Justice executes based on missing health and its cooldown drops hard by rank 4-5 (80s to 50s to 20s) — don't sit at low HP once he's rank 3+ on it.

playing.title: Use E's passive shred on armor stackers
playing.detail: Apprehend passively lets your physical damage ignore a percentage of his Armor even without activating the pull — this matters more once he's building Plated Steelcaps or armor items into you.

playing.title: Reset R on kills
playing.detail: If Noxian Guillotine lands as a killing blow its cooldown refreshes briefly — look to dive a second target or reset for a skirmish immediately after securing the trade.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner picks, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the matchup reasoning and timing calls are my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Maintain your passive stacks and hit Garen at the edge of Decimate [Q]. Use [E] whenever he stands in range to fight him.
